name: Cauliflower Fritters with Tzatziki, Smoked Salmon, Greens & Pine Nuts
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
Transfer cooked cauliflower rice to a medium bowl. Add eggs, flour, and spices, then stir to combine the fritter mixture. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches if necessary, using a ¼-cup measure, scoop the cauliflower mixture into the skillet, spacing each scoop a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed). Place in a large bowl along with pine nuts and vinaigrette. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Chop or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide salad and fritters between plates; top fritters with tzatziki and salmon. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
